name: Koitsura Erosugi!
source:
Main character Hiroki is a college student on vacations. His sister comes to live next room and visits protagonist with another neighbor girl. Hiroki is not really interested in neighbors at first, but he plays a trick on the girls, and it triggers the start of new entertaining and exciting life.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公弘树是一名正在度假的大学生。他的姐姐搬到隔壁房间居住，还和另一名邻家女孩一起前来拜访。弘树起初对邻居们没什么兴趣，但他对女孩们搞了一场恶作剧，由此开启了全新、有趣而刺激的生活。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
